profile.headline: Full-Stack Software Engineer | React · Next.js · Python | AI & LLM Integration
profile.summary:
Full-Stack Engineer with a focus on building scalable web applications and AI-driven automation. I bridge the gap between high-performance frontend architectures (React/Next.js) and robust backend systems (Python/FastAPI).

My approach is rooted in three things: 1. Accessibility & Performance: Ensuring web apps work for everyone while maintaining 90+ Lighthouse scores. 2. Process Automation: Using LLMs and custom data pipelines to eliminate manual business bottlenecks. 3. Engineering Rigor: Writing clean, tested code that reduces regression and scales with the business.

Currently exploring the intersection of Generative AI and B2B productivity tools.

positions.title: Freelance Software Engineer
positions.description:
Architected an AI-driven B2B Prospecting Engine for a local small business, utilizing Python (FastAPI) and PostgreSQL to automate lead discovery.
Engineered an automated data pipeline integrating Google Places and Apollo.io APIs, reducing manual lead-sourcing time for the client by ~15 hours per week.
Integrated Google Gemini API to perform lead scoring and generate personalized sales scripts, increasing outreach efficiency and conversion potential.
Consulted on technical infrastructure and WordPress development, modernizing UI patterns to drive positive business outcomes.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
Built reusable React components and product features from Figma designs, delivering consistent, responsive UIs and reducing duplicate engineering work.
Improved accessibility by delivering WCAG-compliant UI patterns using semantic HTML and ARIA roles, helping the team meet compliance requirements and improving Lighthouse scores by 15%.
Integrated UI with REST and GraphQL APIs, refining data contracts to reduce integration issues.
Increased test coverage by ~30% by adding Jest and React Testing Library tests, improving reliability and reducing regression bugs.
positions.insights: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG), Jest and +4 skills

positions.title: IT Technician
positions.description:
Processed tickets utilizing ServiceDesk in an efficient and timely manner, reconciling all tickets submitted within the same day.
Inspected and diagnosed Six Flags’ systems/machinery across the theme park and resolved real-time hardware and software issues.
Modified personnel systems permissions and streamlined customer feedback intake using ActiveDirectory.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Developed, tested, and debugged scripts to further automation of BlackLine’s application setup process for new developers using PowerShell.
Streamlined the assigned project’s development using Jira to track various tickets/tasks from project start to completion.
Wrote and updated developer documentation in Stash for effective utilization of new scripts.
Centralized each Platform team member’s application version on main team project to enhance workflow
Attended daily syncs with PMs and engineers and pitched solutions to improve the Powershell project.

projects.title: Harry Potter Quiz
projects.description:
Developed a full-stack trivia web app using Next.js API routes and PostgreSQL, serving randomized quiz data on each load.
Designed a responsive, interactive UI with TailwindCSS and implemented secure backend logic.
Deployed on Vercel, demonstrating ability to independently deliver and maintain a full-stack solution.

projects.title: AI Chatbot (Baymax)
projects.description:
Built an AI-powered chatbot with Google Gemini API, utilizing TypeScript, React, Next.js, and TailwindCSS to create a responsive UI.
Deployed on Vercel, integrating natural language processing (NLP) for dynamic, character-style conversations.
